g.title: Site — A geographical surface that can be identified on a map. Properties: siteCode, siteName, measurementSystemCode

Plant — An assembly of equipment that perform a physical or chemical process, including production, transportation and storage. A Plant represents the 'high level' function to be performed, and during the design, a Plant is decomposed in Process Units and Tags. Properties: plantCode, plantName, siteCode, isoLanguageCode, measurementSystemCode, industrialComplexCode

ProcessUnit — A decomposition of the 'high level' Facility function into more granular 'sub-functions'. This facility breakdown structure is decided by the process engineer. Properties: plantCode, processUnitCode, processUnitName
Area — A geographical surface occupied by a Plant. A plant area is created to identify the physical location of an equipment within a plant. Properties: plantCode, areaCode, areaName

ConstructionAssembly — A grouping of tags intended to be assembled and installed as a whole. Tag modules are created to facilitate fabrication during the project. Properties: plantCode, constructionAssemblyCode, constructionAssemblyName, parentConstructionAssemblyCode

CommissioningUnit — A grouping of tags (if the commissioning unit is at the lowest level in the structure), or sub-commissioning units, by the commissioning discipline. This grouping allows one to perform commissioning activities. Properties: plantCode, commissioningUnitCode, commissioningUnitName, parentCommissioningUnitCode
LeafNodeCommissioningUnit — A commissioning unit that is at the lowest level in the hierarchical structure of commissioning units. Properties: plantCode, commissioningUnitCode

MaintenanceUnit — A grouping of maintenance system by the maintenance discipline. This grouping allows one to perform maintenance activities. Properties: plantCode, maintenanceUnitCode, maintenanceUnitName

MaintenanceSystem — A grouping of tags that can be maintained at the same time. Maintenance systems are defined by the maintenance discipline. Properties: plantCode, maintenanceUnitCode, maintenanceSystemCode, maintenanceSystemName, maintenanceSystemActualStartupDate

CorrosionLoop — A grouping of tags with similar operating conditions, e.g. pipe, equipment, .. (i.e., made of similar materials of construction, sharing similar corrosion/degradation rate). Corrosion Loops are created to monitor the corrosions of equipment and thus are important to establish proper inspection strategies. Properties: plantCode, corrosionLoopCode, corrosionLoopName, corrosionLoopDescription, corrosionLoopTypeCode, corrosionLoopProcessDescription, corrosionTypeDescription
CorrosionLoopType — A classification of corrosion loops. Properties: corrosionLoopTypeCode, corrosionLoopTypeName

Tag — An object designed for performing functional requirements and serving as a specification for equipment. Properties: plantCode, tagName, tagDescription, parentTagName, processUnitCode, areaCode, constructionAssemblyCode, commissioningUnitCode, maintenanceUnitCode, maintenanceSystemCode, corrosionLoopCode, tagClassName, tagStatus, tagRequisitionNumber, designedByCompanyName, productionCriticalItemIndicator, safetyCriticalItemIndicator, safetyCriticalItemGroupCode, safetyCriticalItemReasonAwarded, manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName

TagAlias — An alternate name under which a tag may be designated. These aliases are exchanged between the parties. Their origin may be historical, or alternate naming used by the different parties. But they should always have mapping to the official tag name. Properties: plantCode, tagAliasName, tagName

IndustrialComplex — A number of discrete or interconnected plants, together with the associated buildings. Definition inspired by ISO 10209 term 'Industrial Complex'. In ISO 15926 RDL it is defined by INDUSTRIAL COMPLEX. Properties: industrialComplexCode, industrialComplexName, siteCode

TagPhysicalConnection — A physical connection between tags. This information is primarily used for mechanical completions. For piping this information can be generated from 3D models. For electrical and instrumentation, this information can be generated from design tools. For pipes, the direction From To is the direction of the flow within the pipe. For electrical cables, the direction From To is the direction of the electrical current. For drivers (e.g., electrical motor), the From To is the direction of the flow of energy, consistent with ISO15926 and ISO22274. For an instrument having only one connection, the From is the Tag the instrument is mounted on (e.g., the vessel). For a valve, not causing a line break, the From is the line the valve is mounted on. For auxiliary equipment (e.g., a filter), the From is the Tag where the auxiliary equipment is mounted on. Properties: fromPlantCode, fromTagName, toPlantCode, toTagName

Company — A legal entity engaged in business as a proprietorship, partnership, corporation, or other form. Properties: companyName, manufacturerIndicator, supplierIndicator, companyContactPerson, companyContactPersonFunction, companyAddressLine1, companyAddressLine2, companyAddressLine3, isoCountryCode, companyTelephoneNumber, companyFaxNumber, companyEmailAddress

PurchaseOrder — A commercial document used to request a third party to supply goods or services in return for payment. Properties: purchaseOrderIssuerCompanyName, purchaseOrderNumber, purchaseOrderDate, purchaseOrderDescription, purchaseOrderReceiverCompanyName, projectCode

PurchaseOrderItem — An item on a purchase order. The tag, not the model, are necessarily known at the time the purchase order is placed. But the specifications of what is needed are known, and hence the equipment class is known. Properties: purchaseOrderIssuerCompanyName, purchaseOrderNumber, purchaseOrderItemNumber, purchaseOrderItemDescription, manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName, purchaseOrderItemInitialExpectedDeliveryDate, purchaseOrderItemLatestRevisedDeliveryDate, purchaseOrderItemQuantity, unitOfMeasureName
PurchaseOrderItemTag — A tag, or part of it, as covered in a purchase order item. Properties: purchaseOrderIssuerCompanyName, purchaseOrderNumber, purchaseOrderItemNumber, plantCode, tagName
EngineeringStatus — A phase of the engineering activities. Properties: engineeringStatusCode, engineeringStatusDescription
SafetyCriticalItemGroup — A classification of tags according to safety requirements. Properties: safetyCriticalItemGroupCode, safetyCriticalItemGroupDescription

ModelPart — A type of equipment that is manufactured by a manufacturer. A Manufacturer/Supplier's catalogue contains the list of 'Model Part' that a manufacturer can build. Properties: manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName, modelPartDescription, equipmentClassName, modelPartType, shelfLife, shelfLifeUnitOfMeasureName, drawingPositionNumber, originalModelPartManufacturerName, originalModelPartName

Equipment — A physical device designed to perform a function. Properties: equipmentCode, plantCode, tagName, equipmentClassName, manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName, equipmentManufacturerSerialNumber, equipmentActualPurchaseDate, vendorCompanyName, equipmentActualInstallationDate, equipmentActualStartupDate, equipmentPrice, isoCurrencyCode, equipmentWarrantyEndDate, purchaseOrderIssuerCompanyName, purchaseOrderNumber, purchaseOrderItemNumber
IsoCurrency — A currency, as recognised by the ISO organisation in its 4217 standard. Properties: isoCurrencyCode, isoCurrencyName
IsoCountry — A country, as recognised by ISO in its 3166-1 standard. Properties: isoCountryCode, isoCountryName

EquipmentModelPart — A model part, present in a manufacturer or vendor catalogue, or a custom designed model intended for installation as an equipment. Properties: manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName, modelPartDescription, equipmentClassName, shelfLife, shelfLifeUnitOfMeasureName, drawingPositionNumber, originalModelPartManufacturerName, originalModelPartName

SparePart — A part, either non-repairable or repairable, from the associated bill of material used to maintain or repair machinery or equipment. Definition inspired by IEC 62550 Spare parts provisioning. Properties: manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName, modelPartDescription, equipmentClassName, shelfLife, shelfLifeUnitOfMeasureName, drawingPositionNumber, originalModelPartManufacturerName, originalModelPartName

Kit — A kit comprises a number of items supplied under a single part number which is used to undertake a manufacturer’s approved repair scheme. A kit may include spare parts, special tools and consumables. Definition inspired by IEC 62550 Spare parts provisioning. Properties: manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName, modelPartDescription, equipmentClassName, shelfLife, shelfLifeUnitOfMeasureName, drawingPositionNumber, originalModelPartManufacturerName, originalModelPartName

SelectableModelPartForTag — A model part that can be selected for the implementation of a tag. The model part is selectable when the tag and the model part are part of the same tag or equipment class, or when the tag class and the equipment class have a relationship. Properties: plantCode, tagName, manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName

SpecialTool — A tool that is specifically required in conjunction with model parts, for example a tool intended to install a model part. Definition inspired by IEC 62550 Spare parts provisioning. Properties: manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName, modelPartDescription, equipmentClassName, shelfLife, shelfLifeUnitOfMeasureName, drawingPositionNumber, originalModelPartManufacturerName, originalModelPartName

Consumable — Any item which is expendable, may be regularly replaced and generally is not product specific, for example oil, grease, nuts, bolts and screws, gaskets, etc. Definition inspired by IEC 62550 Spare parts provisioning. Properties: manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName, modelPartDescription, equipmentClassName, shelfLife, shelfLifeUnitOfMeasureName, drawingPositionNumber, originalModelPartManufacturerName, originalModelPartName

KitComponent — Defines the model parts that are included in a kit. Definition inspired by IEC 62550 Spare parts provisioning. Properties: kitManufacturerCompanyName, kitModelPartName, manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName, numberOfItemsInKit

TagOrEquipmentClass — A tag class or an equipment class. A tag or equipment class can be at the same time a tag class and an equipment class. The two are not mutually exclusive. Properties: tagOrEquipmentClassName, parentTagOrEquipmentClassName, tagOrEquipmentClassDefinition, tagClassIndicator, equipmentClassIndicator, abstractClassIndicator, tagOrEquipmentClassExistenceReasonDescription, cfihosUniqueCode
TagClass — A classification of tags according to the functions they are required to perform. Properties: tagClassName, tagNumberFormat, equipmentExpectedToBeInstalledIndicator
EquipmentClass — A classification of equipment and equipment models, according to its physical assembly of component(s). Properties: equipmentClassName, sparePartInformationRequiredIndicator

TagClassEquipmentClassRelationship — An equipment class that can be used to implement the function of a tag class. For example a Tag classified as a 'pump' could have an equipment installed classified as a 'centrifugal pump' or a 'rotary pump' but it would not make sense to have a 'flow transmitter' installed as this technology cannot satisfy the functional requirements of a pump. Properties: tagClassName, equipmentClassName, tagOrEquipmentClassRelationshipReasonForMapping
NonAbstractTagOrEquipmentClass — A tag or equipment class that is not marked as abstract. Properties: tagOrEquipmentClassName
TagOrEquipmentClassSynonym — An alternate name used to designate a tag or equipment class. Properties: tagOrEquipmentClassSynonymName, tagOrEquipmentClassName

SourceStandard — A standard used to define requirements like engineering, operations, etc. In the RDL, this table only contains the entries for public standards. Owners / operators are expected to download them in their database, and then to 'complement' that list with their own standards. Properties: sourceStandardCode, sourceStandardDescription, sourceStandardStillToBeCompletedIndicator

TagOrEquipmentClassSourceStandard — A tag or equipment class whose engineering information is documented in a source standard. Properties: sourceStandardCode, tagOrEquipmentClassName, applicationConditionGroupCode

SourceStandardDocumentAndDataRequirement — A requirement for document or data, as expressed in a source standard, irrespective of the equipment class. These Document and Data Requirements are of two kinds: 1) Design: Information generated during the design activity that has to be approved and reviewed by the purchaser. 2) Equipment: Information generated by the equipment manufacturer. This entity represents how to best manage this data, as all document and data requirements expressed in a standard are independent of the equipment classes the standard is covering. In the RDL, this table only contains the entries for document and data requirements as expressed in public standards. Owners / operators are expected to download them in their database, and then to complement that list with their own document and data requirements for their standards. Properties: sourceStandardCode, sourceStandardDocumentAndDataRequirementNumber, sourceStandardDocumentAndDataRequirementTitle, sourceStandardDocumentAndDataRequirementTypicalDeliverable, sourceStandardDocumentAndDataRequirementDescription, documentAndDataRequirementTypeCode, documentAndDataRequirementGroupCode, engineeringStandardSourceChapter, disciplineCode, documentTypeShortCode, defaultSubmitAtProposalIndicator, defaultSubmitForReviewIndicator, defaultSubmitAtDeliveryIndicator, defaultIssueForReviewNumberOfWeeks, defaultIssueForReviewReferenceDate, defaultIssueForApprovalNumberOfWeeks, defaultIssueForApprovalReferenceDate, defaultForInformationNumberOfWeeks, defaultForInformationReferenceDate, defaultRequiredHandoverStatusCode, defaultRequiredTranslationIndicator, deliverableFormatCode, cfihosUniqueCode, sourceStandardDocumentAndDataRequirementComment

ApplicationCondition — A condition under which some document or data requirements have to be applied. Properties: applicationConditionCode, applicationConditionDescription, tagOrEquipmentClassName, propertyName, comparisonOperatorCode, applicationConditionValue, unitOfMeasureName, cfihosUniqueCode

SourceStandardDocumentAndDataRequirementCondition — The application of a given condition to a source standard document and data requirement. Properties: sourceStandardCode, sourceStandardDocumentAndDataRequirementNumber, applicationConditionCode, applicationConditionValue, sourceStandardDocumentAndDataRequirementInclusionIndicator

DocumentAndDataRequirementType — A classification of the document and data requirements according to when / by whom the information is generated. Properties: documentAndDataRequirementTypeCode, documentAndDataRequirementTypeDescription

DocumentAndDataRequirementGroup — A classification of the document and data requirements according to their nature. This classification originates from JIP33. Properties: documentAndDataRequirementGroupCode, documentAndDataRequirementGroupName

SubmissionReferenceDate — A reference date or point in time vs which some actions need to be accomplished. Properties: submissionReferenceDateCode, submissionReferenceDateName, timeUnitOfMeasureName, submissionReferenceIsAfterEventTypeIndicator, eventTypeCode, cfihosUniqueCode
EventType — A classification of events that are used as reference in the handover of information for capital facility projects. Properties: eventTypeCode, eventTypeName

ApplicationConditionGroup — A grouping of application conditions, that have all to be satisfied to be able to say that the condition group is satisfied. An application condition group returns a value true if all the application conditions associated with it are true. The same application condition group can be used for multiple mappings of tag or equipment classes to source standards. Properties: applicationConditionGroupCode, applicationConditionGroupDescription

ApplicationConditionGroupMember — An application condition that is used as a component, or member of an application condition group. Properties: applicationConditionGroupCode, applicationConditionCode

ComparisonOperator — An operator that compares one expression with another. The result of the comparison can be True, False, or Unknown. Comparison operators include the typical ones, recognised by all DBMSes, but also entries like 'IN', to check if the left member of the comparison is present in a list of values, separated by semicolon, in the right member of the comparison. Properties: comparisonOperatorCode, comparisonOperatorName
VendorDocument — A document, originating from a vendor. Alias vendor document schedule. Properties: documentNumber, plannedFinalRevisionDate, actualFinalRevisionDate, vendorDocumentUpdateDescription

PurchaseOrderItemVendorDocumentAndDataRequirement — A vendor document and data requirement (VDDR) deemed to be appropriate jointly by the purchaser and the vendor for a given purchase order. The Purchaser specifies for each VDDR the dates at which the Vendor shall send the corresponding information to the purchaser (e.g. issue for review date). During the ITT process the Vendor shall review the PO_VDDR and confirm: - The relevance of the VDDR's requested with regard to the equipment being requisitioned. For packages, the Vendor shall take into account all ancillary equipment, e.g. on a pump package there may be pulsation dampers, which may be deemed to be pressure vessels. -The ability to meet specified VDDR's submittal dates. Following review, the Vendor will make adjustments according to the ITT clarification process regarding the VDDR omissions. The Vendor shall sign the agreed PO_VDDR. After PO award, a revised requisition package will be submitted to the Vendor with a revised PO_VDDR. The Vendor shall sign the revised PO_VDDR. Properties: purchaseOrderIssuerCompanyName, purchaseOrderNumber, purchaseOrderItemNumber, purchaseOrderVendorDocumentAndDataRequirementNumber, sourceStandardCode, sourceStandardDocumentAndDataRequirementNumber, submitAtProposalIndicator, submitForReviewIndicator, submitAtDeliveryIndicator, dateRequiredForInformationSharing, dateRequiredForFinalReview, dateRequiredForApproval, requiredHandOverStatusCode, translationRequiredIndicator, purchaserComment, contractorComment, vendorComment, documentNumber

PurchaseOrderItemExpectedEvent — An event, other than the purchase or the delivery, that needs to be monitored for the delivery of the requirements. Properties: purchaseOrderIssuerCompanyName, purchaseOrderNumber, purchaseOrderItemNumber, eventTypeCode, purchaseOrderItemEventOriginalEstimatedDate, purchaseOrderItemEventLatestRevisedDate

PurchaseOrderItemForModelPart — A purchase order item for a model or a part. Properties: purchaseOrderIssuerCompanyName, purchaseOrderNumber, purchaseOrderItemNumber, manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName
PurchaseOrderItemForBulk — A purchase order item for some goods in bulk. Properties: purchaseOrderIssuerCompanyName, purchaseOrderNumber, purchaseOrderItemNumber
PurchaseOrderItemForTag — A purchase order item that refers to one or more tags. Properties: purchaseOrderIssuerCompanyName, purchaseOrderNumber, purchaseOrderItemNumber
DeliverableFormat — A format required to be used by the supplier of information in conformance with JIP33 standard. Properties: deliverableFormatCode, deliverableFormatDescription
CodingSource — A system that has similarities to CFIHOS, and has been coding the objects relevant to CFIHOS in a different way. Properties: codingSourceCode, cfihosCodingEquivalentSourceDescription
CfihosObjectEquivalentMapping — A code assigned by a coding source to a tag class. Properties: codingSourceCode, cfihosUniqueCode, cfihosCodeEquivalentValue

Property — A type of feature that is used to distinguish and describe tags, equipment, models) or their class. Alias attribute, characteristic. Properties: propertyName, propertyDefinition, propertyDataType, propertyDataTypeLength, cfihosUniqueCode, propertyExistenceReasonDescription, unitOfMeasureDimensionCode, propertyPicklistName
DataType — A classification of data elements according to their nature. Properties: dataTypeCode, dataTypeName

QuantitativeProperty — A type of feature that (a) is used to distinguish and describe tags, equipment, models or their class (b) is numeric (c) may have an associated unit of measure. Properties: propertyName, unitOfMeasureDimensionCode

QualitativeProperty — A type of feature that (a) is used to distinguish and describe tags, equipment, models or their class (b) may have defined list of values to select from (c) is non-numeric. Properties: propertyName, propertyDataTypeLength, propertyPicklistName

UnitOfMeasureDimension — A grouping of units of measure that relate to the same kind of quantity. The term 'kind of quantity' is defined and used in ISO 80000. Properties: unitOfMeasureDimensionCode, unitOfMeasureDimensionName, cfihosUniqueCode
UnitOfMeasure — A unit that qualifies the size of a quantity. Properties: unitOfMeasureName, unitOfMeasureSymbol, unitOfMeasureDimensionCode, measurementSystemCode, uneceCode, cfihosUniqueCode
PropertyPicklist — A set of possible values that can be assigned to a property. Properties: propertyPicklistName, cfihosUniqueCode

PropertyPicklistValue — A predefined value that can be assigned to a property, in the context of a property picklist. Properties: propertyPicklistName, propertyPicklistValueCode, propertyPicklistValueDescription, cfihosUniqueCode, sourceStandardCode

TagOrEquipmentClassProperty — A characteristic, or property, that a tag or equipment class has. Properties: tagOrEquipmentClassName, propertyName, imperialUnitOfMeasureName, siUnitOfMeasureName, propertyIsRelevantForTagIndicator, propertyRelevantForEquipmentIndicator, propertyRelevantForModelPartIndicator, cfihosUniqueCode
TagClassProperty — A characteristic, or property, that a tag class has. Properties: tagClassName, propertyName

EquipmentClassProperty — A characteristic, or property, that an equipment class has. Properties: equipmentClassName, propertyName, propertyRelevantForEquipmentIndicator, propertyRelevantForModelPartIndicator

TagProperty — A characteristic, or property, that a tag has. Properties: plantCode, tagName, propertyName, tagPropertyValue, tagPropertyMarginRatio, reasonForDeviatingFromStandardUnitOfMeasure, processStreamCode, processActivityCode, unitOfMeasureName

ModelPartProperty — A characteristic, or property, than an equipment model has. Properties: manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName, propertyName, modelPartPropertyValue, reasonForDeviatingFromStandardUnitOfMeasure, unitOfMeasureName

EquipmentProperty — A characteristic, or property, that an equipment has. Properties: equipmentCode, propertyName, equipmentPropertyValue, reasonForDeviatingFromStandardUnitOfMeasure, unitOfMeasureName

TagOrEquipmentClassPropertySourceStandard — A tag or equipment class property that is reported by a source standard in its data sheet. Properties: tagOrEquipmentClassName, propertyName, sourceStandardCode, sourceStandardSection, propertyNameInSourceStandard, propertySequenceNumber, cfihosUniqueCode
MeasurementSystem — A collection of units of measure related to each other. Properties: measurementSystemCode, measurementSystemName

UnitOfMeasureSynonym — A synonyms that uniquely identifies or represents a unit of measure. This has been introduced as it is anticipated that not source standards may use e.g. the same symbol to represent the unit of measure. However a synonym should never point to two different units of measure. Properties: unitOfMeasureName, unitOfMeasureSynonymName

TagOrEquipmentClassPropertyApplicationCondition — A condition that applies to the capture or supply of a tag or equipment class property. If there are no application condition for the supply of a tag or equipment class property then the value of the property should be supplied. Properties: tagOrEquipmentClassName, propertyName, applicationConditionCode, applicationConditionValue

PropertyGroupAllowedForPurpose — A group of properties that can legitimately be used for a given purpose. The same property group can be used for multiple purposes, but not for all purposes. Properties: propertyGroupCode, propertyGroupingPurposeCode, cfihosUniqueCode

PropertyGroup — A grouping of properties. Property groups can be used for multiple purposes. But if a property group can be used for a given purpose, then it should be documented as a property group allowed for that purpose. Properties: propertyGroupCode, parentGroupCode, propertyGroupDescription, sourceStandardCode, cfihosUniqueCode
PropertyGroupingOrDecompositionPurpose — A reason, or purpose, for which properties need to be grouped. Properties: propertyGroupingPurposeCode, propertyGroupingPurposeDescription, cfihosUniqueCode

PropertyToGroupAssignment — A reason or purpose for which properties need to be grouped. The same property group can be used for multiple purposes, but not for all purposes. Properties: tagOrEquipmentClassName, propertyName, propertyGroupingPurposeCode, propertyGroupCode, propertySequenceNumber, cfihosUniqueCode

TagOrEquipmentClassComponent — A component of what makes a tag or equipment class. Properties: tagOrEquipmentClassName, componentRoleName, tagOrEquipmentClassComponentName, tagOrEquipmentClassComponentMinimumNumberOfComponents, tagOrEquipmentClassComponentMaximumNumberOfComponents, tagOrEquipmentClassComponentTypicalNumberOfComponents, tagOrEquipmentClassComponentToBeAddedIndicator, tagOrEquipmentClassComponentIsLogical, propertyGroupCode, cfihosUniqueCode
ComponentRole — The role of the component of the Tag or Equipment Class. Properties: componentRoleName, componentRoleDescription, cfihosUniqueCode

ProcessClass — A classification of the process activities according to the type of action / operation being performed. DEXPI and ISO15926 provide good starting points for the list of process classes. Properties: processClassName, processClassDefinition, cfihosUniqueCode
ProcessClassTagClassRelationship — A tag class that can be used to implement a process activity belonging to a process class. Properties: processClassName, tagClassName

ProcessClassProperty — A property that should be specified for process activities related to this process class. Properties: processClassName, propertyName, siUnitOfMeasureName, imperialUnitOfMeasureName

ProcessActivity — A set of actions by which material, energy or information is transformed, transported or stored. Processes can be decomposed in sub processes, also known as process steps. Properties: processActivityCode, parentProcessActivityCode, processActivityDescription, processClassName
ProcessActivityTagRelationship — A tag that implements (part of) the functional requirements of a process activity. Properties: processActivityCode, plantCode, tagName

ProcessDesignProperty — A property that is required by a given process activity. This property is often the result of some governing case, to allow for all possible scenarios to be taken into account. Properties: processActivityCode, propertyName, processDesignPropertyValue, unitOfMeasureName
StreamClass — A classification of the process streams according to what is being moved. Properties: streamClassCode, parentStreamClassCode, streamClassDescription, cfihosUniqueCode

ProcessStream — A flow of material, energy or information produced by one process activity and consumed by another process activity. A process stream depicts the interaction between process activities. Properties: processStreamCode, processStreamDescription, outputOfProcessActivityCode, inputOfProcessActivityCode, streamClassCode
StreamClassProperty — A property that should be specified for process streams related to this stream class. Properties: streamClassCode, propertyName, siUnitOfMeasureName, imperialUnitOfMeasureName
ProcessStreamProperty — A property that is required for a process stream. Properties: processStreamCode, propertyName, processStreamPropertyValue, unitOfMeasureName
ProcessCase — A scenario of how processes and streams would perform under some conditions. Properties: processCaseNumber, processCaseDescription, applicationConditionGroupCode
ProcessActivityInCase — A process activity included in the scope of a case. Properties: processCaseNumber, processActivityCode
ProcessPropertyInCase — A property of a process activity, in the context of a case. Properties: processCaseNumber, processActivityCode, propertyName, processPropertyValueInCase, unitOfMeasureName
ProcessStreamInCase — A process stream included in the scope of a case. Properties: processCaseNumber, processStreamCode
ProcessStreamPropertyInCase — A process stream property, in the context of a case. Properties: processCaseNumber, processStreamCode, propertyName, processStreamPropertyValueInCase, unitOfMeasureName
UnitOfMeasureDimensionApplication — Indicates which unit of measure dimension codes are relevant for a unit of measure. Properties: unitOfMeasureName, unitOfMeasureDimensionCode, cfihosUniqueCode

PropertyPicklistValueSourceStandard — Indicates where the standard that specifies the need for the Property Picklist Value. Properties: propertyPicklistName, propertyPicklistValueCode, sourceStandardCode
Discipline — A branch of knowledge of expertise which is responsible for the content of the deliverable. Properties: disciplineCode, disciplineName, disciplineDescription, cfihosUniqueCode
DocumentType — A classification of documents. Properties: documentTypeShortCode, documentTypeName, documentTypeDescription, cfihosUniqueCode, documentTypeClassification

DisciplineDocumentType — An identification of what type of document is required for what discipline, and what are their delivery requirements. Discipline document type is NOT a distribution list. Properties: disciplineCode, documentTypeShortCode, disciplineDocumentTypeShortCode, assetTypeReference, representationType, reviewType, disciplineDocumentTypeComment, nativeDocumentFormat, nativeFileDeliveryTiming, authenticatedRecordFormat, hardcopyDocumentRequired, translatedDocumentRequired, cfihosUniqueCode
DocumentTypeClassification — A classification of document types according to their nature. Properties: documentTypeClassificationCode, documentTypeClassificationDescription
AssetType — A classification of discipline document types according to the type of asset they refer to. Properties: assetTypeCode, assetTypeDescription
DocumentRepresentationType — A classification of the documents according to how they should be represented. Properties: documentationRepresentationTypeCode, documentationRepresentationTypeDescription
NativeFileDeliveryTiming — An indication of when the native file should be available. Properties: nativeFileDeliveryTimingCode, nativeFileDeliveryTimingDescription
DocumentFormat — A format, or package, that has to be used to provide a given type of document. Properties: documentFormatCode, documentFormatDescription
HandoverEvent — A phase, a moment, at which handover of information is taking place. Properties: handoverEventName, handoverEventDescription, handoverEventReportingSequenceNumber

DisciplineDocumentTypeHandoverRequirement — An indication of the status that a document type should have, if any, at a given handover event, for a given discipline. Properties: disciplineCode, documentTypeShortCode, handoverEventName, requiredDocumentStatusForTheHandoverEvent

DocumentMaster — A placeholder that allows a project to identify a particular information content to be created or updated. A document master is identified by a document number, and it groups all the document revisions created to mature the information content. An index of document masters is called a Master Document Register (MDR), and it allows a project to plan when the information content will reach a particular status (e.g., AFC, ASB). Remark: The first issuance of the document Master will be the baseline plan. Subsequent issuances will reflect any changes in forecast dates. Properties: documentNumber, documentTitle, disciplineDocumentTypeShortCode, documentReviewType, forecastReviewDate, forecastApprovalDate, forecastApprovedForDesignDate, forecastApprovedForConstructionDate, forecastAsBuiltDate
IsoLanguage — A language, as recognised by ISO in its 639-1 standard. Properties: isoLanguageCode, isoLanguageName
DocumentReviewType — A type of review that is required for a document. Properties: documentReviewTypeCode, documentReviewTypeDescription

DocumentRevision — A user-readable set of data structured in order to be printed and stored as a whole (includes drawings). Disciplines specify the content of the documents delivered. The file provided (See FILE_NAME property) shall be: - The most used rendition (when than one rendition is given for the same document). - The entry point for the document (e.g., the table of content, when the document has been split into multiple files). Remark: - All files generated in PDF format shall be text-searchable with commenting enabled. - All files shall be fully virus checked by the Contractor before submission. Properties: documentNumber, documentRevisionCode, documentRevisionDate, documentRevisionAuthor, documentRevisionApprover, documentRevisionFileName, originatorDocumentNumber, originatorDocumentRevisionCode, originatorFileName, documentStatusCode, isoLanguageCode, documentRevisionComment, plantCode, exportControlClassification, originatorCompany, projectCode, transmittalNumber, documentRevisionRecipient, actualReviewDate, actualApprovalDate, actualApprovedForDesignDate, actualApprovedForConstructionDate, actualAsBuiltDate, documentRevisionPhysicalStorageLocation, storageMedia, projectStage, regulatoryRequiredIndicator, documentReturnStatusCode
Transmittal — An exchange of information between two companies. Properties: sendingCompanyName, projectCode, transmittalNumber, numberOfMedia, transmittalSendDate, reasonForIssue
ReasonForIssue — The reason for which transmittals are issued. Properties: reasonForIssueCode, reasonForIssueDescription

AdditionalFile — A file that makes up a particular document revision. In some circumstances, a particular document revision can be made up of more than one file. Examples include: - Native files - Translations of a document - Large documents that have been split into several smaller files When this is the case, all these files shall be provided as a 'set of files'. Properties: documentNumber, documentRevisionCode, fileTitle, fileName, storageMedia, isoLanguageCode
DocumentRevisionSiteReference — A reference to a site that is included in a document revision. Properties: documentNumber, documentRevisionCode, siteCode
DocumentRevisionPlantReference — A reference to a plant that is included in a document revision. Properties: documentNumber, documentRevisionCode, plantCode
DocumentRevisionProcessUnitReference — A process unit that is referred to in a document revision. Properties: documentNumber, documentRevisionCode, plantCode, processUnitCode
DocumentRevisionPlantAreaReference — A facility area that is referred to in a document revision. Properties: documentNumber, documentRevisionCode, plantCode, areaCode
DocumentRevisionTagReference — A tag that is referred to in a document revision. Properties: documentNumber, documentRevisionCode, plantCode, tagName
DocumentRevisionModelPartReference — A model part that is referred to in a document revision. Properties: documentNumber, documentRevisionCode, manufacturerCompanyName, modelPartName
DocumentRevisionEquipmentReference — An equipment that is referred to in a document revision. Properties: documentNumber, documentRevisionCode, equipmentCode

DocumentRevisionCrossReference — A reference to a document revision in another document revision. Properties: documentNumber, documentRevisionCode, referencedDocumentNumber, referencedDocumentRevisionCode

DocumentRevisionPurchaseOrderReference — A purchase order that is referred to in a document revision. Properties: documentNumber, documentRevisionCode, purchaseOrderIssuerCompanyName, purchaseOrderNumber
Project — A temporary endeavour undertaken to create an asset or a service. Properties: projectCode, projectName
DocumentRevisionProjectReference — A project that is referred to in a document revision. Properties: documentNumber, documentRevisionCode, projectCode
DocumentStatus — A status that a document, revision can have during its lifecycle. Properties: documentStatusCode, documentStatusDescription
ExportControlClassification — A rule that applies to some goods and services when being exported. Properties: exportControlClassificationCode, exportControlClassificationDescription
ProjectStage — A phase through which a project goes from conception to implementation. Properties: projectStageCode, projectStageName
StorageMedia — A type of technology used to store some documents. Properties: storageMediaCode, storageMediaDescription
LifeCycleActivityClass — A classification of activities in the life cycle of a capital asset. Properties: lifeCycleActivityClassCode, lifeCycleActivityClassDescription
DocumentReturnStatus — A status assigned to a document revision after review. Properties: documentReturnStatusCode, documentReturnStatusDescription
ModelPartType — Indicates the type of model part for the item in this SPIR. Properties: modelPartType, modelPartTypeDescription

SparePartInterchangeabilityRecord — A recommendation from the Vendor or Manufacturer of the spares they think the owner operator should purchase for the equipment supplied. Also commonly known as a SPIL or RSPL. Properties: spirReference, purchaseOrderIssuerCompanyName, purchaseOrderNumber, spirContactPerson, commercialConditions

SparePartInterchangeabilityRecordEquipment — List of goods purchased as part of the original purchase order. Properties: spirReference, equipmentDescription, plantCode, tagName, numberOfUnitsProcured, numberOfPartsPerUnit, parentEquipmentDescription

SparePartInterchangeabilityRecordCommercialDetails — Prices and delivery information for all items. Properties: spirReference, modelPartName, manufacturerCompanyName, purchaseQuantityUnitOfMeasureName, quotedPrice, quotedPriceIsoCurrencyCode, quotedDeliveryTime, quotedDeliveryTimeUnitOfMeasureName
